question: How is the supreme power related to the principles and all seeds?
premises: She is associated with the twenty-four principles
She embodies the nature of all seeds
inference: The supreme power is associated with the twenty-four principles and is the very form of all seeds.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of caturviṃśatiḥ tatvaiḥ to svarūpiṇī is compressed
plain_english: With the twenty-four principles, she is of the nature of all seeds.
